verdict.rationale: Jan's README lists both local models downloaded from HuggingFace and cloud integration with OpenAI, Anthropic, Mistral, Groq, MiniMax and others. Its docs say you can 'switch freely between local and frontier models' and 'plug in your favorite online models' alongside open models in the same app. Missing for 10: detailed docs on configuring cloud providers (API keys, per-chat switching), and independent or hands-on corroboration of mixed local/cloud use.
